ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Ransomware or Unauthorized MBR Tampering Via Bcdedit.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential malicious and unauthorized usage of bcdedit.exe

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\bcdedit\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "bcdedit\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*delete.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*deletevalue.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*import.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*safeboot.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*network.*")))
